Test fonts
==========

mplus1p-supplementary-subset.ttf and mplus1p-bmp-subset.ttf are subsets of
M+ 1p Regular (mplus1p-regular-webfont.ttf), Copyright 2016 The M+ Project
Authors, licensed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1
(https://openfontlicense.org). The licence text is also in the name table of
each file.

- mplus1p-supplementary-subset.ttf: ASCII, U+7530, U+1D538, U+20B9F, U+20BB7
- mplus1p-bmp-subset.ttf: ASCII, U+7530
